messages:
Priya Malhotra: Heads-up for tomorrow's co-announce: we need a short, unambiguous handoff ledger for SI-origin leads. Keep it 1 page so partners actually read it.
Carlos Ruiz: Agreed. Key ask: who owns demo scheduling vs who owns opportunity follow-up. Let's make the default: partner = scheduling & discovery, Redwood = offer/closure & renewals.
Nora Feldman: Suggest a 'handoff ticket' object with minimal fields: acct_id, partner, claimed_at, claim_state (claimed|awaiting-evidence|approved|released), prior_owner, evidence_url, notes. One-line human reason too.
Evan Cho: For contested cases: require the prior owner to flag within 48h. If flagged, manager mediation within 24h. If no decision -> default to prior owner. Document this in the ledger.
Rhea Kapoor: Ops ask: can marketplace show an inline trigger so partner AEs can create a handoff ticket from listing page? Minimal command: `/create-ticket --acct=ACCT123 --partner=acme-int` which returns ticket_id.
marketplace-bot: ticket-service: created ticket TKT-2023 for ACCT123 status=awaiting-evidence
Priya Malhotra: Evidence rules: partners must upload either meeting notes or a short recording within 72h of claim. If missing, ticket auto-releases back to Redwood AE.
Carlos Ruiz: We also need a 'no-demo' flag for accounts pending legal/compliance. If set, marketplace blocks scheduling and shows tooltip: "Awaiting compliance clearance".
Nora Feldman: Reconciliation: daily CSV to partnerships-sre with columns: acct_id, ticket_id, partner, claim_state, claimed_at, evidence_present, prior_owner, last_event_ts. And a weekly summary for finance.
Evan Cho: Automation: propose timers - 36h stale-> regional AE auto-assign; 72h evidence TTL -> release; 7d orphan -> partnerships alerts. I'll implement as background jobs on the ticket-service.
Rhea Kapoor: UI: show badge "claimed-by <partner>" and state pill. Also add a tiny CTA "request-release" that pings prior owner and creates a 24h reclaim window.
marketplace-bot: ticket-service: event=timer_set ticket=TKT-2023 timers=[36h_auto,72h_evidence]
Priya Malhotra: Crediting: if partner provides evidence and runs the demo, partner gets initial pipeline credit. If split work at conversion, require manager sign-off and record split percentages on the ticket. Primary owner for renewal must be set on opp creation.
Carlos Ruiz: Action items: Evan - add timers + auto-assign job; Rhea - add create-ticket command and UI badge; Nora - CSV spec and sample export; Priya - write the 1-page ledger and post Confluence link.
Nora Feldman: I'll produce sample CSV by EOD today and include field descriptions.
Evan Cho: Will post sample payloads for the webhook and the ticket lifecycle events.
Rhea Kapoor: I'll mock the small UX flow and drop screenshots in the Confluence doc.
Priya Malhotra: Great. If we ship this quick ledger + ticket flow before the announcement, partners won't be surprised and finance has an auditable trail. Will post link when done. :sparkles:
